independent_statistics_repeat.interpretation: Independent final estimates compared within 7 combined Monte Carlo standard errors + 2/N + 1e-8. Agreement tests stability at this statistical precision; it is not a bound on physical or spatial quadrature errors.

angular_refinement.interpretation: Independent final estimates compared within 7 combined Monte Carlo standard errors + 2/N + 1e-8. Agreement tests stability at this statistical precision; it is not a bound on physical or spatial quadrature errors.

limitation: These comparisons test Monte Carlo stability and angular refinement at the reported statistical precision. Spatial quadrature and remaining physical approximations are not validated.
